## What is JavaScript?
JavaScript runs in the browser and on servers via Node.js.

## Hello in the browser
Open DevTools Console and type:

```js
console.log('Hello, web!');
```

## Node.js script
Create `hello.js`:

```js
// hello.js
console.log('Hello, Node!'); // Print to stdout
```

Run:

```bash
node hello.js
```
